svg.title: Finite records: from an OPH source to a detector
svg.desc: Five distinct finite constructions: charged transfer and energy, interacting cube preparation, revised spatial field records, charged finite clusters, and charged spatial records. Complete outcomes and exact error bounds are retained. Physical particle identities and GeV masses remain unproved.
svg.text: THE FINITE FIELD LABORATORY
From source dynamics to complete detector records
Read each lane left to right. Each lane declares its own Hamiltonian, preparation, references and clock. A change of source is shown explicitly; results from different lanes are
not silently combined into a particle claim.

svg.text: A · NATIVE CHARGED SOURCE
Same interacting Hamiltonian; ordered arrival and energy experiment.
Prepare a charge
The actual uᶜ, dᶜ or Q operator changes a native
block. An explicit reference carries the
compensating charge; the preparation partner
remains.
These are source Y changes, not confirmed quark flavours.
Let it transfer
A gauge link couples two complete blocks. The
source evolves autonomously for one time unit
before the arrival detector acts.
P₀ B† T Pₑ T B P₀ = P₀ / 128
Positive transfer residue; every nonarrival outcome
stays.
Measure the energy
After arrival, measure the active source plus its
fixed reference. The energy operator is identity
on the retained partner.
uᶜ/dᶜ source excitation interval; reference cost 4
removed.
Keep the whole law
The original record includes failed preparation,
nonarrival, every spectral bin and all dark
residues. Changing measurement order is a
separate experiment.
88 / 88 / 160 record labels
Arrival backaction is included. This is not a rest mass.

a.text: Proof, exact source definitions and all retained outcomes

svg.text: B · COMPLETED INTERACTING CUBE
Same completed cube and raw energy convention; explicit finite apparatus services.
Retain every sector
The finite source contains native code,
occupation complement, charge references and
photon cap. A positive completion selects its
code ground.
Code + complement + references
No discarded states are hidden by a projection.
Prepare, then herald
Four independently prepared copies undergo
recorded code admission. Three finite energy-
agreement filters select a common low-energy
state.
4 copies · 4096 pointer labels
All rejections remain; six service slots use the same
clock.
Bound the error
The successful prepared state approximates the
coupled ground. Exact finite control services and
background-cancellation work are declared.
Conditional purification error, with total photon cap
Read the interaction
A complete selected matter–field record has
positive original probability after all
preparation factors. The small cube is a finite
quantum system.
Original selected-record probability; not a scattering
cross section.

svg.text: C · REVISED SPATIAL FIELD FAMILY
Explicit orthogonal regulator; fresh prepared sea; actual coupled evolution on growing boxes.
Repair the free slope
An orthogonal regulator Γ separates the lattice
correction from the mass matrix β. The free low-
momentum squared coefficient becomes one.
E² − m² ≈ |p|²
Free comparison only. Vectorlike; finite-spacing P and T
break.
Prepare in one frame
A finite algebraic map transports the free sea
while retaining the same field, charge and Gauss
operators. Every bank and code flag is retained.
h(θ)² ≥ m² I
The open-boundary proof does not assume [K,W] = 0.
Measure coupled records
A recorded electric kick or identity is followed
by the actual coupled wait and a complete
bounded-current readout. Local laws converge at
fixed spacing.
Complete finite-law separation from the zero-coupling
control.
Fix sector selection
A fixed cube penalty fails on large boxes. The
separate source choice c(V)=18V+1 places the
global ground inside the code at every finite
cap.
Complement separation ≥ m
A variational sector result, not the interacting ground
vector.

svg.text: D · CHARGED FINITE CUBE
Explicit completion 23/2; same charge frame and raw offset; photon cap three.
Find a stable cluster
This instrument uses a proved eight-state cluster
in each charge sector. Its uniform interaction
estimate is inconclusive for the first two states
alone.
Gap within Q = ±1. Eight states do not mean eight
species.
Prepare and compensate
Recorded admission and energy agreement prepare
two sources. An even fermionic pump adds or
removes charge; R = −Q and its cost four remain.
Joint parity and Gauss charge kept
The opposite-charge spectra are paired by conjugation.
Record two energies
A charged-source clock and retained neutral-
partner clock resolve the desired joint subspace.
Every failure and every pointer pattern remains.
Original acceptance probability; five complete driven
slots.
Bound what was read
Accepted records lie in the charged cluster and
neutral ground with a rigorous fidelity bound.
The reference-corrected interval contains binding
effects.
Joint fidelity. No continuous spin, rest mass or GeV
assignment.

svg.text: E · CHARGED PREPARED SPATIAL FAMILY
Same growing field and charge frame; nonstationary prepared input; static reference in each member.
Prepare a local charge
A literal local creation or removal acts on the
prepared free sea. An even pointer pump retains
every failure and supplies the Gauss-compensating
reference.
Pump success ≥ 11/20
This state is not the interacting ground.
Send the boundary away
Enlarge the box around the observer. Keep the
reference fixed within each experiment, then
compare sources with that reference farther away.
Complete local records converge
Fixed spacing and bounded time; remote fine flags remain.
Account for its energy
The reference contributes cost four and a
geometry-dependent Coulomb self energy. Subtract
those displayed terms when comparing charged and
neutral preparations.
Eref = 4 + ½ m g² G(root,root)
Corner, face and centre have different finite self
energies.
Read a positive excess
Exact quantum exchange and finite photon bounds
control the prepared energy above the matching
neutral prepared sea. This is an expectation, not
a spectral mass.
A local charge signal is proved at preparation; the mass
remains open.

svg.text: WHAT STILL SEPARATES THESE RECORDS FROM A MEASURED PARTICLE
Prepare the same interacting state across size → extend the finite charged energies to spatial translations → control interacting dispersion and infrared resolution → match
physical spin, statistics and currents → establish dimensionless ratios → attach an energy convention and compare with experiment.
No Standard Model identity, source-derived GeV mass, interacting relativistic ultraviolet limit or early-universe abundance is asserted by this poster.
Exact receipt hashes are embedded in this SVG. Every number is an outward-rounded bound from the linked finite construction.
